    c4 = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 4]
    c6 = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 6]
    if not c4:

    rs = [r for r, c in c4]; cs = [c for r, c in c4]
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)
    out = set()
    if c6:
        a0 = min(r for r, c in c6); a1 = max(r for r, c in c6)
        ac0 = min(c for r, c in c6); ac1 = max(c for r, c in c6)
        # glyph type: fat plus (4-wide bar) -> below; thin plus -> above;
        # T (bar top, stem down) -> right; perp (bar bottom, stem up) -> left
        rows6 = {}
        for r, c in c6: rows6.setdefault(r, set()).add(c)
        bar = max(rows6.items(), key=lambda kv: len(kv[1]))
        is_t = bar[0] == a0          # bar at top of glyph -> T

        # top-row shift quirk: arrow clearly right of shape -> top row shifts +1

        if ac0 > max(cs) + 1 and a0 > r1:  # arrow clearly right & below

        if is_perp:      # copy left

        elif is_t:       # copy right

        else:            # arrow above -> copy below
            out = {(2 * r1 + 1 - r, c) for r, c in cells}
    g = [[0] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for (r, c) in cells | out:
        g[r][c] = 4
    return g
